results.title: Prefeitura de Belo Horizonte — geographic data access
results.note: Documents WFS at https://bhmap.pbh.gov.br/v2/api/idebhgeo/wfs; parcel layer and usable IDs not yet identified.

results.title: PBH FAQ — cartographic base and parceling plans
results.note: Says city base maps can be downloaded and parceling-plan records are accessible in SIURBE; exact parcel layer endpoint not verified.

assessment: Official PBH sources document WFS access and public cartographic downloads, and mention a parceling-plan registry. Search did not identify a citywide cadastral parcel feature layer and stable parcel IDs; this is a material lead for follow-up, not a verified source.
note: Native-language discovery only; does not change the historical registry or assert that no source exists.
